title: Sleepy robot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pillow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='38' ry='13' fill='#8fa8ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='36' ry='11' fill='#b9c9ff'/>
  <!-- body/blanket -->
  <rect x='24' y='58' width='52' height='24' rx='10' fill='#4a7de0'/>
  <rect x='24' y='58' width='52' height='8' rx='4' fill='#6592f0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='40' height='36' rx='12' fill='#c7d6f5'/>
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='40' height='10' rx='8' fill='#dde7fb'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='35' y='28' width='30' height='24' rx='7' fill='#1d2340'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes (closed, glowing) -->
  <path d='M40 39 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#5ff5c8' stroke-width='2.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 39 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#5ff5c8' stroke-width='2.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little sleepy mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#5ff5c8'/>
  <!-- cheek glow -->
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='44.5' r='2' fill='#ff9ecb'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='44.5' r='2' fill='#ff9ecb'/>
  <!-- antenna with sleeping ball -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='50' y2='14' stroke='#a7b8dd' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='4' fill='#ffcf5c'/>
  <!-- "Z" sleep marks -->
  <path d='M70 20 h7 l-7 7 h7' stroke='#ffcf5c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M79 12 h5 l-5 5 h5' stroke='#ffcf5c' stroke-width='1.7' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
